messages.author: 869c02e45ec8b6e5
messages.subject: Urgent help : inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()
parts:
Hi everyone, 

Every time I try to run my code, I get an error that INLA has crashed. 

My code is : 

rprior <- list(theta = list(prior = "pccor1", param = c(0, 0.9)))

formula <- y ~ 0 + b0 + f(s,
                          model = spde, group = s.group,
                          control.group = list(model = "ar1", hyper = rprior)
)

res <- inla(formula,
            data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),
            control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE,
                                     A = inla.stack.A(stk.full)),
            verbose = TRUE)

The error is get is :

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully. If this does not help, please contact the developers. Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts, : *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.

Hi

can you upgrade to R-4.3 and install the most recent testing version of
R-INLA?

I guess the issue is that you're using one or more covariates that are
not scaled, hence creating a numerical issue
